selection_scope: Only the eight stated word spans are priced. Reference fields, other words and the whole-body reading are not the optimization target. Offsets and vocabulary were selected retrospectively from the source-model result.
prior_credit: Published Nov28–Dec1 key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), George Lasry (2017). Earlier OCR/source surveys retain their attribution. Source review, explicitly priced reading and tied-frame certificates: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All384 printed source slots remain in the native transcription. The 374-coordinate reading is conditional on excluding ten source slots; no deletion is silently performed.
All375 contiguous ten-slot exclusions and all2,850 pairs of complete five-coordinate groups are priced against the same eight-word stencil. The latter leaves the final four-coordinate group in place.

Ten contiguous placements tie at seven observed substitutions. The two whole-group minima produce the same ciphertext and select two of the six equivalent source maps, but do not prove historical duplication or a unique layout.

The primary excludes nine valid coordinate glyphs and one printed mask, then makes seven observed substitutions and four retained-source mask fills. Starts11–13 instead exclude ten valid coordinates and leave one printed mask unresolved after the same word repairs.
The key and all numeral/letter labels remain unchanged. Y is the separator in this key; X and XX are retained as literal labels.
GEDRATET, BUCKAREST, MARSCHZ, J43, X4OP, J and XX are not silently regularized or expanded. The recovered places and aviation abbreviations do not identify a historical order or person uniquely.
New source-image files are not distributed. Without --pdf, verification checks the literal text, model and recorded evidence metadata; actual source pixels remain unchecked in that run.
